decks.name: LeetCode #239 - Sliding Window Maximum
decks.description: Find the maximum value in each sliding window of size k

cards.question: Sliding Window Maximum: You are given an array of integers nums, there is a sliding window of size k which is moving from the very left of the array to the very right. You can only see the k numbers in the window. Each time the sliding window moves right by one position. Return the max sliding window.

solutions.name: Deque
solutions.explanation: Use a monotonic decreasing deque to track indices of potential maximum elements. Remove indices outside the current window from the front. Remove smaller elements from the back when adding new elements. The front of the deque always contains the index of the maximum element in the current window.

solutions.name: Dynamic Programming
solutions.explanation: Divide the array into blocks of size k. For each block, compute leftMax (max from left to right) and rightMax (max from right to left). The max of window [i, i+k-1] is max(leftMax[i+k-1], rightMax[i]). This works because any window either fits in one block or spans two blocks.
